description: Trace raster images (PNG, JPG, WebP) into scalable SVG vector paths using Potrace: monochrome black-and-white (with auto Otsu or custom threshold) or stacked multi-colour vector layers (2 to 16 colours). Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.003/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/image-to-svg.

color.description: Foreground HEX or CSS colour name when mode=bw

colors.description: Number of colour layers when mode=color: 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16

detail.description: Tracing detail: smooth, normal or fine

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

invert.description: Trace light regions instead of dark when mode=bw

mode.description: bw (black and white) or color (stacked colour layers)

whiteBackground.description: Add solid white background rectangle when mode=bw

name: image_to_svg
title: Image to SVG Vectorizer API - trace PNG/JPG logos & icons into clean SVG
